resourceName: Inner Mongolia Kuduer Improved Forest Management Project
description: The Inner Mongolia Kuduer Improved Forest Management Project (hereafter “the project”) is located in the central Greater Khingan Mountains of Inner Mongolia, affiliated to Yakeshi City. The project is implemented by Kuduer Forest Industry Co., LTD, a subsidiary of Inner Mongolia Forest Industry Group. Prior to the implementation of the project, the forests in the project area were regarded as commercial forests and harvested annually according to the timber production plan issued by the Kuduer Forestry Bureau. From 01/2020 of the project implementation, harvesting has been strictly cancelled by the project owner, allowing only tending and managing. The project area is a low to medium mountainous terrain. The geographical coordinates of the project are 120°52′05″E～122°35′45″E, 49°36′28″N～50°22′10″N. The dominant tree species within the project area is Larch. The project has approximately 18,233.92 ha commercial forest. According to the Non-Permanence Risk Report, with buffering deducting, the estimated annual emission reduction of the project is 109,790 tCO2e, and the total estimated emission reductions will reach 3,293,696 tCO2e during the 30 years’ crediting period.
